slot.instructions: Which words of the transcript are the thing the command carries verbatim: the address to open, the search terms, the song to play, the text to type, the key to press? Never the command word itself: "play X" carries X. A line with no command word, such as a question, carries itself: its search terms are the line as asked. Choose none when it carries none.

options.none: the command carries no words of its own

amount.instructions: Only when the action skips forward or back in a video or audio, or changes its volume or speed: how far? For a skip, choose words when the words say how far — a number of seconds, or of minutes; otherwise the share of its length the words mean. For the volume or the speed, choose to when the words carry the level, else up or down and how far. Ignored for every other action.

options.words: as far as the words say: the number they carry, in seconds, or in minutes when they say minutes
options.moment: a moment: a hundredth of its length
options.little: a little: a twentieth of its length

options.lot: a lot: a quarter of its length
options.end: all the way: to the end, or back to the start
options.to: the volume or speed to the number the words carry
